Lol at Anthropic & OpenAI managing to make Microsoft look like the good guys for signing things about open weight models. 

And Altman retweets the letter as if him & his nemesis aren't lobbying daddy Trump to stop those "evil" Chinese open source models.
*open weight not open source. I always harp about the difference so don't want to make that mistake here.
The irony of OpenAI and Anthropic running to the government to save them whenever there’s competition and it’s this government that complains about “handouts” and communism.

On the other hand, OpenAI & Anthropic are marching us to the promised utopia any day now, just as long as they get another trillion & cover the planet with data centers. Then we’ll all be zombies breathing polluted air & dating their chatbots. Sounds like a bright future.
